title: Intro post, room, and photo post lifecycles are independent

cases.note: intro_post_commands.rs::deleting_a_post_removes_likes_and_comments_and_nothing_else — snapshots profile_rooms, profile_posts, discovery_favorite_items, profile_media and discovery_profiles before and after the delete and requires every count unchanged; the room and the media file are then asserted to still exist.
The audience lives on intro_posts and nothing in the intro command writes profile_rooms or profile_posts; the delete test above holds the same table snapshot across a post mutation.
Not exercised in this worktree: the room module is WP-07's and is not present here. The intro side of the independence is proven (V-08-a); the room side belongs to WP-07's own evidence.
Not exercised in this worktree for the same reason as V-08-c.
intro_post_commands.rs::publishing_sets_the_state_and_the_instant — a post publishes with no room row in existence; the fixture creates no profile_rooms row for the author.
IntroPost.test.tsx::import boundary — neither IntroPostCard nor IntroPostDetail imports anything from features/profile-room/, and neither renders a room preview or a room link.
intro_snapshot.rs::changing_favorites_after_publishing_leaves_the_snapshot_unchanged — a profile edit after publication does not change the post.

limitations: V-08-c and V-08-d require the WP-07 room module, which is not present in this worktree. They are recorded as PASS on the intro side (the intro lifecycle never reads or writes room state) but the room-to-intro direction is WP-07's evidence, not this package's.
The evidence status is PASS for every case this package can execute; the two room-direction cases are explicitly marked as not exercised here rather than silently claimed.
